explanation: All three points (W=1.5753 GeV, Q2=0.3 GeV^2, cos(theta*)=-0.527586, phi*=36/72/108 deg) passed preflight kinematic checks and ran successfully with EXCLURAD's eta channel using standard CLAS12 settings: 6.53 GeV beam energy (CLAS12 RG-K, the validated eta campaign default), vcut=0.166 GeV^2, and full O(alpha) radiative-correction mode. delta (= sigma_obs/sigma_Born, unpolarized) and sigma_Born (unpolarized Born cross section) were read directly from radtot.dat as EXCLURAD wrote them, with no rounding beyond the code's own output precision.
